sections.content: A sustained argument develops a position across several connected sentences. Introduce the issue, explain causes, present an opinion, consider another view and finish with a proposal. Connectors such as *sin* *embargo*, *además*, por eso and en *conclusión* help organise the argument.

items.spanish: Además, el acceso a ciertos servicios no es igual.
items.english: Furthermore, access to certain services is not equal.

items.spanish: Sin embargo, existen medidas que pueden mejorar la situación.
items.english: However, there are measures that can improve the situation.

items.spanish: En conclusión, la sociedad tiene una responsabilidad compartida.
items.english: In conclusion, society has a shared responsibility.

sections.content: An argument should develop rather than repeat the same opinion. Add causes, evidence, another perspective and a conclusion.
